_readme: ZETA INTEL DASHBOARD - REFRESH DEPENDENCY MAP (single source of truth for UPDATE_DASHBOARD.bat / refresh_all.py).
Created 2026-10-02. refresh.bat is NOT driven by this file and stays the emergency fallback.
MANUAL ONLY (Ahmed, 2026-10-02): nothing here runs automatically -- no scheduler, no watcher, no background job. A build, commit or push happens only when UPDATE_DASHBOARD.bat is double-clicked.
TO ADD A NEW EXCEL SOURCE: add its path (relative to this dashboard folder) to the 'sources' list of every step that reads it. Globs like 'List Intell/*.xlsx' are allowed.
TO ADD A NEW BUILD SCRIPT: add a step object below, in run order. 'depends_on' = steps whose OUTPUT this step reads; when any of them is rebuilt, this step is rebuilt too.
Step fields:
id / label        short id and readable name
commands          list of commands, each a list of args; the first arg is a .py file run with the same Python as refresh_all.py. All must succeed.
critical          true  = a failure STOPS the run and NOTHING is pushed; false = warning, previous cache is kept, push continues.
sources           input files (Excel, CSV, JSON, YAML). A change in any of them triggers the step.
depends_on        upstream step ids (their caches are inputs to this step).
outputs           caches this step writes. Used for validation, version tags and git.
pages             dashboard pages that show this data (ids from 'pages' below).
multi_pass        optional: re-run the command until 'until' text appears in its output (sales).
skip_if_missing   optional: skip the step (not an error) when this file does not exist.
max_age_hours     optional: also run when the step's outputs are older than this (internet feeds).
needs_network     optional: informational; such steps should normally be non-critical.
requires_success_of  optional: skip this step when the named step ran and failed in this run.
in_full           optional (default true): set false to keep a step out of FULL mode (only runs when its own sources change).
git_extra         optional: other generated files the step writes that must be committed with it (not validated, not version-tagged).

validation._note: Sales: a change in ACTUAL sales or units of an existing line-month above max(0.5%, 10,000) is a WARNING; target changes are listed in the report. IQVIA: a removed period, a period total moving more than 0.5%, or any product whose DEFIND Market_1 mapping changed is a WARNING. Warnings pause the push and ask Y/N.

git._note_untrack: 2026-10-02 (Ahmed approved): files that must stay local only. On the next push they are removed from GitHub with 'git rm --cached' (the local file is kept and still generated), and never added again by UPDATE_DASHBOARD. Verified before the change: no dashboard page, loader or fallback loads cache/sales.json -- every page reads cache/sales.data.js; only local build scripts (Coaching) read sales.json. NOTE: refresh.bat and push_now.bat still 'git add -f cache/sales.json'; if either fallback is used, the file goes back to GitHub and the next UPDATE_DASHBOARD run removes it again.
git._note: Commits ONLY the outputs + git_extra files of the steps that ran (or are still waiting to be pushed) plus the version-tag files. Code, docs and other changes in the folder are NOT committed (unlike refresh.bat, which runs 'git add -A'). Set add_all to true to copy refresh.bat's behaviour.
